moments.author: Mark Zuckerberg
moments.quote: Every lab has the responsibility and incentive to move at the pace required to train its models safely… commit majority of compute to serving people over recursive self‑improvement
moments.why: It’s blowing up as Zuckerberg pushes back against AI‑slowdown calls, reshaping the safety debate.

moments.author: Sam Altman
moments.quote: The world is right to be afraid of this… very confident we’ll do the right thing because it’s the right thing
moments.why: Altman’s tweet acknowledging public AI fears while urging trust went viral amid mounting AI anxiety.

moments.author: Marjorie Taylor Greene
moments.quote: California diesel $8.49 but Georgia $6.59, both RIDICULOUS!!!
moments.why: Her post about soaring diesel prices struck a nerve amid fuel‑cost outrage and media coverage.

moments.author: Stephen Curry
moments.quote: My Li‑Ning signature shoe will debut early next year
moments.why: Curry’s announcement is trending among men 25‑45 passionate about sneakers and NBA culture.

moments.author: NC Courage / KC Current
moments.quote: Thank you for everything, G. [Gianna Paul traded to NC Courage for $150,000]
moments.why: A trade announcement by women's soccer team on X getting major buzz among sports fans.
